what: Lookback / look-ahead experiments (local harness; compile settings as in each run's 'settings'). Each variant compiled without the held-out prompts, every held-out prompt typed one key at a time; per policy family, the threshold with the most keystrokes saved at >= 90% precision. joint = extend while the product of probabilities >= tau (old rule); step/stepfine = first word >= tau, then each next word >= ext (new rule); min2/min3 = show nothing unless >= 2/3 words clear tau. Runs named final-* use the larger held-out set (711 prompts + 4,000 WildChat); the rest use 711 + 1,000. wc48r2/wc48r4 = with extra WildChat-4.8M text (not adopted; size not verified). export_mb of stage-2 runs was over-estimated by a since-fixed bug.
